messages.content: So tak what is you

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Call me bot

"call me bot"... legend, i like the energy. but ngl i need your actual name to find you roles. companies don't hire "bot" unfortunately.

what's your real name?
Saurav, Shubham Saurav.
Upstox
Yes

Don't know,  at that time was not able to crack the interviews at that time 
And the pay was good here so yeahh

done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes
If I have 48lpa ish offer in Mumbai, currently  in banglore  then what should I do  I have 20-25 days till I join next company  should I gave a crack to fang or start up

48l in mumbai vs your current bangalore setup... that's a solid bump but not life-changing after taxes and mumbai cost of living.

20-25 days is tight but not impossible for faang. startups could move faster though. what's your risk appetite?
Given I have around 27lpa ish in banglore . My risk appetite is not that much as I support my parents also  need that income coming  but confident in my craft and ability to learn on the job

27 to 48 is a huge jump, especially with family support. that's real money.

given the timeline and risk profile... take the 48l offer. get that income secured, then you can always interview for faang/startups while earning more.
Ooh I have taken that offer as of now

smart move. secure the bag first, always. now you're at 48l with stability, can interview for 60-70l roles from a position of strength.

what's the new company?

It's in Fintech domain , not comfortable sharing the details  of you let me know how you gonna store the data I may let you know
  Global Fintech
12 th Jan , 9th Jan is the lwd here  london based company  2007  , hiring for Mumbai role  especially senior software engineer got the IC2 role instead of ic3

i'm your talent agent - i'll be here when you're ready for the next jump. for now, focus on crushing that ic2 role and getting that ic3 promo.

anything specific on your mind?
exactly. you're in the driver's seat now. ping me if you need anything.
Naah thanks have couple of compaines in loop  one sarvam ai and one open fx  new venture both in banglore

sarvam ai is hot right now. open fx sounds like a new fintech play. both interesting.

since you've got the 48l secured, you can interview with zero pressure. see what they offer, then decide if it's worth jumping again.
Yeah let's see

Thanks tal,  is your name inspired from mikhail tal from chess and from where he was
  Magician of reega
you got it. mikhail tal, the magician from riga. the original agent of chaos.
Ping me when you have some offers untill then have a bang
will do. enjoy the new role.
Hi
Yes magician from riga

exactly. the original chaos agent. now i'm just the chaos agent for your career.

you're locked in. i'll ping when something actually fits.
Sure you said hi

just checking in. you're starting the new role jan 12 right? london-based global fintech, ic2 level instead of ic3.

how's the prep going? any nerves or just pure excitement?

Amazon SDE II: FAANG brand upgrade, matching your SDE-2 level at Upstox.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/rH8J6
application was closed

damn, that was quick. amazon moves fast.

freshworks and sproutsai are still open though. freshworks is solid for backend scale, sproutsai for ai/llm startup chaos.

which one feels more interesting? or you want me to keep hunting for something else?

hey, saw a senior backend role at a fintech/blockchain platform

fully remote, senior level (sde-3 equivalent), golang stack

they ask for 5+ years but you're at 4 - could be a good stretch. salary not listed though

golang focus though, which is different from your current stack

it's healthcare not fintech though, and salary not listed

      - Company: Jobgether
      - Location: Not specified

      - Job Description: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Platform - Onboarding) in India . This role provides a unique opportunity to contribute to a high-impact, mission-driven platform that supports global user onboarding and compliance operations. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain scalable backend services that ensure seamless onboarding experiences for users worldwide. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and senior leadership, to turn strategic product goals into robust technical solutions. The role emphasizes building systems that scale efficiently across multiple countries and products, improving user conversion funnels, and enabling rapid product launches. You will have ownership over complex problems, apply modern cloud technologies, and maintain high standards of code quality and system reliability. This is an ideal position for engineers who thrive in fast-paced, innovative environments and are passionate about shaping the future of financial technology platforms. Accountabilities Build and maintain backend services and APIs to support global onboarding and KYC processes. Design scalable, reliable systems using modern cloud technologies and industry best practices. Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers to convert product visions into actionable roadmaps. Debug and resolve complex technical problems while ensuring systems are maintainable, secure, and operationally efficient. Review feature designs for security, operational integrity, scalability, and architectural clarity. Continuously optimize backend processes to improve user onboarding and conversion metrics globally. Contribute to a culture of high-quality code, documentation, and technical excellence across the team. Requirements 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a strong focus on backend development. Proven experience designing, building, and scaling production-grade services and service-oriented architectures. Proficiency in Golang and experience with modern cloud infrastructure and backend technologies. Familiarity with database systems such as Postgres, MongoDB, or DynamoDB, and experience with Docker or containerized deployments. Solid understanding of system design, coding best practices, and maintaining secure and reliable platforms. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative and transparent approach to teamwork. Passion for building financial systems that are open, scalable, and globally impactful. Nice to have: experience with blockchain technologies, growth experimentation, or A/B testing frameworks. Benefits Remote work with flexible arrangements (India-based). Competitive salary and performance incentives. Opportunities to work on cutting-edge blockchain and fintech platforms. Collaborative, high-performance culture with continuous learning opportunities. Participation in company-wide offsites and team events to foster connection and alignment. Exposure to global-scale platform engineering, system design, and backend architecture challenges. Jobgether is a Talent Matching Platform that partners with companies worldwide to efficiently connect top talent with the right opportunities through AI-driven job matching. When you apply, your profile goes through our AI-powered screening process designed to identify top talent efficiently and fairly.  Our AI evaluates your CV and LinkedIn profile thoroughly, analyzing your skills, experience, and achievements.  It compares your profile to the job’s core requirements and past success factors to determine your match score.  Based on this analysis, we automatically shortlist the three candidates with the highest match to the role.  When necessary, our human team may perform an additional manual review to ensure no strong profile is missed. The process is transparent, skills-based, and free of bias — focusing solely on your fit for the role. Once the shortlist is completed, we share it directly with the company that owns the job opening. The final decision and next steps (such as interviews or additional assessments) are then made by their internal hiring team. Thank you for your interest! By submitting an application to this posting, the applicant acknowledges that Jobgether will process their personal data as necessary to evaluate their candidacy, provide feedback, and, when appropriate, share relevant information with potential employers. Such processing is carried out on the basis of legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures in accordance with applicable data protection laws. The applicant may exercise their rights of access, rectification, erasure, and objection at any time as provided under the GDPR. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Show more Show less

      - Concerns: Asks for 5+ years and you have 4 years - slight experience gap but not a dealbreaker, Jobgether is a recruitment platform posting on behalf of a partner - actual company name not disclosed, Golang is primary language (not Node.js/Java/Python that you likely specialize in) - would need to assess your Go experience, No clear salary range mentioned, unclear if it meets your 50L+ requirement
      - Reasoning: This is a good stretch opportunity for you. It's a Senior role (one level up from your current SDE-2), fully remote like you need, and in fintech/blockchain. Yeah, they want 5+ years and you have 4, but that's the kind of reach that makes it exciting - not impossible. The Golang requirement might be new for you, but if you've got backend fundamentals, it's learnable. Main question is whether the salary hits your 50L+ target, since it's not listed.
